The simulation is a transient 2D axisymmetric spray combustion case using OpenFOAM.
The solver is sprayFoam (Lagrangian spray with evaporation and combustion; the combustion sub-model uses an eddy-dissipation/PaSR approach consistent with the global two-step chemistry).
The chamber is a cylindrical domain modeled as a 5-degree axisymmetric wedge, with length 0.2 m in the axial (x) direction and radius 0.05 m in the radial direction, axis along the centerline.
The mesh is created with blockMesh as a 100 x 50 (axial x radial) grid, with grading concentrating cells near the axis and near the injector face at x=0.
The wedge geometry spans x=0 to x=0.2 and r=0 to r=0.05, spanning ±2.5 degrees about the axis plane, with the centerline defined using the 'axis' boundary type.
Turbulence is modeled with the standard k-epsilon model with standard wall functions on the walls.
Liquid n-dodecane (C12H26) is injected from the center of the inlet face (x=0, r=0) in the +x axial direction using a cone injection model with a cone half-angle of 15 degrees.
The liquid mass flow rate is 0.002 kg/s, injected continuously for the entire run, with droplet injection temperature of 300 K.
The droplet size distribution is Rosin-Rammler with a mean diameter of 50e-6 m and a spread parameter of 2.
The droplet evaporation/heat-mass transfer model is RanzMarshall, and the drag model is the standard sphere drag model.
The gas inlet at x=0 is a co-flow air inlet with velocity (10 0 0) m/s, temperature 800 K, pressure 101325 Pa, and mass fractions O2 = 0.233 and N2 = 0.767.
The operating pressure is 101325 Pa.
The initial condition fills the entire chamber with hot air at rest (U = 0, T = 800 K, O2 = 0.233, N2 = 0.767) at 101325 Pa.
The outlet at x=0.2 uses totalPressure for p with p = 101325 Pa and zeroGradient for all other fields.
The walls use noSlip for velocity and fixed temperature of 400 K; the wedge side planes use wedge type and the axis uses axis type.
Combustion chemistry is a two-step global mechanism for dodecane placed in constant/reactionSchemes with an accompanying constant/combustionProperties configuration, using janaf thermodynamics for all species (C12H26, O2, N2, CO, CO2, H2O).
Step 1: C12H26 + 11.5 O2 → 12 CO + 13 H2O (fuel partial oxidation).
Step 2: CO + 0.5 O2 ⇌ CO2 (CO oxidation), treated as reversible.
The combustion model is eddy-dissipation-based or PaSR as implemented for global chemistry in the spray solver, using janaf thermodynamic data.
Gravity is not specified; use gravity off (or a uniform (0 0 0) g) unless otherwise needed.
The controlDict specifies endTime 0.05 s, adjustTimeStep yes, maxCo 0.7, writeControl adjustableRunTime, and writeInterval 0.001 s, producing 50 result snapshots.
The run is transient, starting from rest with the spray injection active from t=0.
